verticals.h2: Made for the room it hangs in
verticals.lede: Seven kinds of business, the sizes that work in each, and a sign you can open in the designer with your own words.

bullets: Behind the bar, 100 to 150 cm wide reads from the door without shouting over the room.
Classics that earn their keep: Last orders, Bar open, the pub's own name above the optics.
Brick and dark panelling eat light, so warm white and amber look richest at night.
Above the machine or the counter, 60 to 100 cm keeps it friendly rather than corporate.
Your name, a menu favourite, or a line customers photograph: Coffee first, Fresh today.
Cafés are bright by day, so pick a coloured jacket: the tube keeps its colour when it is off.
Beside the mirrors, 60 to 80 cm frames the selfie without filling the shot.
Your salon name or a one-liner clients share: Fresh cuts, Hair goals, Book in.
Ice blue and soft pink flatter skin tones under ring lights better than red.
On the training wall, 100 to 150 cm can be read from the far end of the room.
Short and loud works best: the gym name, No excuses, One more rep.
Red, orange and electric blue hold up against bright overhead lighting.
In reception, 80 to 120 cm behind the desk is the size visitors remember.
Your logo, redrawn from your artwork as a free mockup, or the company line in clean type.
Warm white on oak or charcoal looks considered; brand colours come from the 12 tube colours.
Inside the window, 60 to 100 cm, hung from chains in the top third, reads from across the street.
Open, Open late, the shop name, or your opening hours on a second line.
Facing daylight, choose a coloured jacket so the sign still reads when it is switched off.
Several signs for one venue or a run of events, quoted together with one proof per design.
Backdrops at 150 to 200 cm, table signs at 40 to 60 cm, and everything in between.
Staged delivery is possible when signs are needed at different venues or dates.

price.lede: Every price is worked out from the same rules the designer uses, so these examples move with them. Your mockup carries the exact figure.

cards.title: Size
cards.body: The width and letter height set how much tube and acrylic go in.

cards.title: Letters and tube length
cards.body: Longer words and joined script use more tube than a short, bold name.

cards.title: Colours and RGB
cards.body: One colour is included. Each extra line colour and colour-changing RGB tube add to it.

cards.title: Backing and finish
cards.body: Cut to shape in clear acrylic is included. Rectangles, stands and mirror finishes cost more.
